title: Gentle Shoulder Compression
summary: The palms gently and rhythmically compress the muscular tissues over the upper shoulders without sharp pinching.
goal: Provide even, comfortable compression to the soft tissues of the shoulder girdle.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of gentle compression over the upper shoulder muscles.
startingPosition: The shoulders are lowered and relaxed. The hands rest over the soft upper shoulder tissues.
instructions: Enclose the soft shoulder tissue with the palm and fingers.
Gradually increase pressure to a comfortable level.
direction: Compression is directed into the soft shoulder tissue without moving toward the front or side of the neck.
tips: Make sure the person is not tensing or lifting the shoulders.
mistakes: Pressing with the fingers into the side of the neck.
warning: Do not compress areas with swelling, recent injury, marked tenderness, or inflammation.
telegramCaption: Gentle rhythmic compression of the upper shoulder muscles.
